admin_users_form_email_too_long: Email must be {max} characters or fewer
admin_users_form_name_too_long: Name must be {max} characters or fewer
admin_users_form_birth_day_whole: Birth day must be a whole number
admin_users_form_birth_day_range: Birth day must be between 1 and 31
admin_users_form_birth_year_whole: Birth year must be a whole number
admin_users_form_birth_year_range: Birth year must be between 1900 and the current year
admin_users_form_anniversary_invalid: Anniversary must be a valid date
admin_users_form_guardianships_failed: User updated but failed to update guardianships. Please update manually.
admin_users_form_perms_guardian_not_allo: A guardian always has full access to their child's lists, so it can't be changed here.
admin_users_form_perms_restricted_not_al: Some users cannot be set to restricted (partner or guardian relationships are always full view).
admin_users_form_perms_failed: User updated but failed to update permissions. Please try again.
admin_users_form_viewer_guardian_not_all: This user's guardian always has full access, so it can't be changed here.
admin_users_form_viewer_restricted_not_a: Some lists cannot be set to restricted (partner or guardian relationships are always full view).
admin_users_form_viewer_failed: User updated but failed to update list-access permissions. Please try again.
admin_users_form_birth_year_help: Optional. Used only to tailor recommendations and the user's experience. Never displayed publicly.
admin_users_form_guardians_help: Guardians are responsible for a child user. They can edit the child user's lists as well as impersonate them.
admin_users_form_anniversary_help: Optional. Saved to both partners so the date shows on either profile.
admin_users_actions_description: Actions on the account itself. These take effect right away, separately from saving the form.
admin_users_relationships_description: People this user shops for on Mother’s Day and Father’s Day.
admin_users_permissions_description: What each person can do with {#strong}{name}{/strong}'s wish lists. Partners and guardians always have full view.
admin_users_list_access_description: What {#strong}{name}{/strong} can see of other people's wish lists. Partners and guardians always have full view.
admin_users_danger_description: Permanently delete this user. Their lists, items, claims, comments, and partner/guardian links will all be removed.
admin_users_delete_body: This permanently deletes the account, all lists they own and every item, claim, and comment on those lists, all gift claims they made on other users' lists, all guardianship and partner links, and their stored avatar.
admin_users_delete_self_error: You can't delete your own account from here.
admin_users_delete_not_found: User not found. They may have already been deleted.
admin_users_reset_body: We'll email {#strong}{email}{/strong} a link to reset their password. The link expires after a short time. They stay signed in on existing sessions until they finish the reset, which then signs those sessions out automatically.
admin_users_reset_skipped: Email isn't set up on this deployment, so no message was sent.
admin_users_ban_enable_body: This user will be able to sign in again immediately.
admin_users_ban_disable_body: This blocks new sign-ins and revokes all active web and mobile sessions. The account itself stays intact and can be re-enabled later.
admin_users_ban_self_error: You can't change your own login state from here.
admin_users_password_description: Sets a new password directly and revokes all active sessions. The user will need to sign in again with the new password.
admin_users_password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
admin_users_password_self_error: You can't change your own password from here.
admin_users_create_guardians_failed: User created but failed to assign guardians. Please update manually.
admin_users_create_partner_failed: User created but failed to update partner record. Please update manually.
admin_users_create_access_failed: User created but failed to apply default list access. Please set it manually in the edit dialog.
admin_users_create_access_label: Default Access to Other Users' Lists
admin_users_create_access_help: Sets what this new user can see of everyone else's lists. {#strong}View{/strong} is the default (they can see others' public lists). {#strong}Restricted{/strong} lets them view and claim but hides others' purchases. {#strong}None{/strong} hides everyone else's lists entirely. Partners and guardians always keep full view. You can fine-tune this per person later from the edit dialog.
admin_users_dependent_delete_body: Lists for {name} that already have received gifts will be archived (kept for history); everything else is removed permanently.
admin_users_dependent_remove_guardian_bo: {guardian} will no longer manage {name} and will lose edit access on their lists.
This user will no longer manage {name} and will lose edit access on their lists.
admin_users_banned_tip: This user is banned and cannot sign in
admin_users_role_tip_admin: Admin: full access to /admin and every user account
admin_users_role_tip_child: Child: managed by a guardian and can't create gift-ideas lists
admin_users_guardian_badge_tip: Guardian: can manage one or more child accounts
admin_users_impersonate_select_required: Please select a user to impersonate
admin_users_page_impersonation_descripti: Impersonate a user to see the app as they do.
admin_users_page_dependents_description: Non-user gift recipients (pets, babies, anyone managed by another user). Click a row to edit. Their guardians manage the lists themselves.
admin_users_page_add_dependent_descripti: Pick at least one guardian. Guardians see the dependent on /me and /received, and can pick them when creating a list.
admin_perms_role_legend_user: {#strong}User:{/strong} the default role. Has their own lists, can claim gifts on others' lists, and manages their own profile.
admin_perms_role_legend_admin: {#strong}Admin:{/strong} everything a User can do, plus access to this admin area. Admins can create users and dependents, change permissions, impersonate other users, and run the import and export tools.
admin_perms_role_legend_child: {#strong}Child:{/strong} an account the child signs in to themselves, managed by one or more guardians. They can own lists but can't claim gifts on others' lists, can't be a partner, and can't be a guardian themselves.
admin_perms_matrix_description: Who can view or edit whose lists. Each row shows what that person can do with the lists of the person in each column. Dependents only appear as columns, since they're always recipients and never viewers.
admin_perms_tip_guardian_access: Can view and edit all of {ownerName}'s lists.
admin_perms_tip_denied: {ownerName} has explicitly denied {viewerName} from viewing their lists.
admin_perms_tip_restricted: {ownerName} has restricted {viewerName} to visible items only, with no addons and no edits.
admin_perms_legend_guardian_hint: Full view and edit access to a child user
admin_perms_legend_restricted_hint: Can claim, but only sees unclaimed items and no addons
admin_data_reveals_description: Lists with claimed or off-list gifts their recipient can't see yet. They reveal on their own on the date shown. Reveal one early when the gifts were already given, for example purchases logged after that occasion's reveal. Your own lists show without a count.
admin_data_reveal_error_not_found: That list no longer exists or is archived.
admin_data_reveal_error_not_applicable: This list type isn't revealed from here.
admin_data_reveal_done_own: They're on your Received Gifts page.
admin_data_reveal_done_own_email: They're on your Received Gifts page, email sent.
admin_data_reveal_done_other_email: {items} item(s) and {addons} off-list gift(s) revealed, email sent.
admin_data_reveal_empty: No lists have hidden gifts right now.
admin_data_reveal_confirm_body_own: Every claimed item and off-list gift still hidden on this list becomes visible to you on your Received Gifts page, along with who gave it. Use this for gifts that were already given, such as purchases logged after the fact. This can't be undone in bulk.
admin_data_reveal_confirm_body_other: Every claimed item and off-list gift still hidden on this list becomes visible to {recipientName} on their Received Gifts page, along with who gave it. Use this for gifts that were already given, such as purchases logged after the fact. This can't be undone in bulk.
admin_data_reveal_send_email_label: Send the Reveal Email (If That Occasion's Emails Are On)
admin_data_page_export_description: Download a JSON snapshot of all app data.
admin_data_page_import_description: Restore app data from a previously exported JSON snapshot.
admin_data_page_purge_description: Permanently delete every list, item, claim, comment, addon, and editor record. Users, guardianships, and partner links are kept. This can't be undone.
admin_data_import_mode_merge_description: Insert each row from the backup, or update it if a row with the same primary key already exists. Nothing is deleted.
admin_data_import_mode_wipe_description: Delete all existing app data (including every user and all sessions), then insert rows from the backup. You'll be signed out and will need to sign in again.
admin_data_import_error_admin_missing: Your account is not in the backup
admin_data_import_error_snapshot_require: Wipe refused: pre-wipe snapshot could not be written
admin_data_purge_confirm_body: This permanently deletes every list, item, claim, comment, addon, and editor record across all users. User accounts, guardianships, and partner links are kept. Item images are also removed from storage where possible. This can't be undone.
admin_nav_auth_oidc_description: Let users sign in with an external OpenID Connect provider. Each deployment supports one provider, and changes take effect after a server restart. Signing in from the iOS app also needs at least one mobile redirect URI above.
admin_nav_barcode_description: Choose the providers behind {#code}POST /api/mobile/v1/products/by-barcode{/code}. The iOS app uses the result to prefill its add-item sheet. The endpoint never creates items itself.
admin_nav_barcode_history_description: Recent barcode lookups from the iOS app (newest first, capped at 200), including cache hits, misses, and provider errors. Inspect any row to see the candidates the provider returned and who scanned it. Lookups are kept for 90 days by default.
admin_nav_barcode_dialog_description: Recent barcode lookups (newest first, capped at 200). Click the inspect icon on any row to see the candidates and raw results.
admin_nav_email_description: Configure the Resend integration used for all transactional email. Values provided via environment variables take precedence and cannot be edited here.
admin_nav_general_comments_description: Item comments and the related email notifications.
admin_nav_general_birthday_description: Birthday lists, automatic archiving after a birthday, and birthday emails.
admin_nav_general_christmas_description: Christmas-themed lists, automatic post-holiday archiving, and seasonal emails.
admin_nav_general_holiday_description: Generic holiday lists (Easter, Mother's Day, Halloween, and more), with auto-archiving after each holiday and an optional email summary.
admin_nav_general_holidays_available_des: The holidays users can pick from when creating a holiday list. Add one from the built-in gift-giving catalog or create your own. Deleting a holiday that's in use switches its lists to the default list type and keeps their claims.
admin_nav_general_reminders_description: Reminders for Mother's Day, Father's Day, Valentine's Day, and partner anniversaries. Each one has its own on/off switch, lead time, and email setting. Turning one off also hides its related profile field (parent labels or anniversary date).
admin_nav_general_todo_description: Allow users to create todo lists.
admin_nav_general_observability_descript: Optional error reporting and metrics, off by default. Each one needs its environment variable (DSN or token) set and its toggle turned on. Data only goes to the backends you configure.
admin_nav_mcp_clients_description: Apps that registered themselves to connect. Disable one to revoke its access and block new sign-ins; delete it to also forget every consent. Real clients simply register again next time.
admin_nav_mcp_connections_description: Every user-to-client connection that can still sign in. Revoking one signs that assistant out for that user.
admin_nav_mcp_client_disabled: Client disabled and its connections revoked
admin_nav_mcp_delete_body_named: {name} will lose every connection and consent. Users who still use it will be asked to connect again.
admin_nav_mcp_delete_body: This client will lose every connection and consent. Users who still use it will be asked to connect again.
admin_nav_mcp_revoke_body_client_user: {client} will be signed out of {user}'s account immediately.
admin_nav_mcp_revoke_body_client: {client} will be signed out of this user's account immediately.
admin_nav_mcp_revoke_body_user: The assistant will be signed out of {user}'s account immediately.
admin_nav_mcp_revoke_body: The assistant will be signed out of this user's account immediately.
admin_nav_photo_description: The AI vision extractor behind {#code}POST /api/scrape/photo{/code}. The Upload Photo option when adding an item uses the same endpoint to prefill a draft. Use this page to check that your AI model can actually return a ScrapeResult from a photo before you offer the feature to users.
admin_nav_scheduling_endpoints_descripti: Each row is a registered {#code}/api/cron/*{/code} route. {#em}Last success{/em} goes amber when the gap exceeds three intervals, which usually means the scheduler has stopped firing.
admin_nav_scheduling_history_description: Every run is logged here. History is kept for the retention period you set (90 days by default) and cleaned up daily by the verification-cleanup job.
admin_nav_scraping_settings_description: Time limits for every scrape, and how long results stay cached by URL. AI-specific settings are under {#em}AI{/em}.
admin_nav_scraping_bulk_description: Settings for bulk import on the list edit page. The scrape queue is a background cron job that fills in details from each item's URL after the items are created.
admin_nav_scraping_providers_description: Set up the providers used to import items from URLs. The built-in fetch provider is always on. Configure any others below.
admin_nav_scraping_health_description: Success rates for each provider, plus the domains and error codes that fail most often in the selected time range. Successes are counted on the server. Failures are loaded individually (up to 5,000) so they can be grouped by domain from their actual URLs.
admin_nav_scraping_history_description: Recent scrape attempts (newest first, capped at 200). Inspect any row to see the full response data, the per-column extracted fields, and which user triggered the scrape.
admin_nav_scraping_dialog_description: Recent scrape attempts (newest first, capped at 200). Click the inspect icon on any row to see the full response data, the per-column extracted fields, and which user triggered the scrape.
admin_nav_storage_settings_description: Behavior that runs whenever items are saved with external image URLs.
admin_nav_storage_browser_description: Every object in the configured bucket. Rows are classified as {#strong}attached{/strong} when a user or item still references them, or {#strong}orphan{/strong} when nothing in the database points at the key. Bulk-delete orphans or remove a single object below.
